member.name: T:AOPC.WebApi.Controllers.ApiUploadController
member.summary: Generic image upload endpoint used by every maintenance module's image/logo/gallery fields (Business Type, Hotel, Vendor, Membership Tier, Offering, Registration profile photo). Replaces the old CMS's several near-identical per-module UploadFile actions with one reusable endpoint: save the file, return its URL, then the caller includes that URL in the normal Save request. The original is stored exactly as uploaded (no re-encoding), under a per-module category folder, e.g. /uploads/business-types/guid.jpg — plus a small resized copy (UploadPaths.ThumbnailSuffix, via SkiaSharp, a cross-platform/MIT-licensed successor to the old CMS's deprecated/Windows-only System.Drawing.Bitmap resize) saved alongside it, since table listings only need a ~44px thumbnail and downloading the full original for that was the actual cause of slow-loading thumbnails. Also exposes DeleteImage so callers can clean up the file(s) an image field previously pointed at once it's replaced/removed.

member.name: M:AOPC.WebApi.Controllers.ApiUploadController.TryCreateThumbnail(System.String)
member.summary: Best-effort: a thumbnail is a display optimization, not something an upload should fail over (e.g. a corrupt/unsupported-by-SkiaSharp file still saved fine as the original above). Downscales only — an original already smaller than ThumbnailMaxDimension is skipped rather than upscaled into a larger, blurrier "thumbnail". GIFs are decoded to their first frame only, which is fine for a small static table icon.

member.name: M:AOPC.WebApi.Controllers.ApiUploadController.DeleteImage(System.String)
member.summary: Best-effort cleanup for a file an image field previously pointed at, once it's been replaced or removed — called by the client only for a bare "/uploads/..." path (never for a legacy absolute URL, which points outside this app entirely). Always resolves the path against the uploads root and confirms it stays inside it before deleting, so a crafted "../" segment can't be used to delete anything else on disk. Idempotent: a missing/invalid/external path is a silent no-op, not an error, since the caller has no real recourse if cleanup fails anyway.

member.name: M:AOPC.WebApi.Controllers.ApiUploadController.SanitizeCategory(System.String)
member.summary: Folder-name-safe category (letters, digits, hyphens only); anything else — including an absent category, or an attempt to smuggle path-traversal segments — collapses to "misc".

member.name: T:AOPC.WebApi.Controllers.HealthCheckController
member.summary:
Health check and system monitoring endpoint.
This controller provides two primary capabilities: 1. Real-time server resource monitoring (CPU, memory, disk usage) 2. On-demand SQL Server database backup operations
Both endpoints require authorization and return structured responses suitable for monitoring dashboards or maintenance tasks.
Ports AuthSystem.Data.Controller.HealthCheckController almost as-is — it was already the most "modern-looking" controller in the legacy codebase. This port injects IRepository<User>/ IRepository<Corporate>/IRepository<AuditTrailEntry> directly (rather than adding a thin IHealthCheckService wrapper) since the original's two inline EF queries are trivial, single-use, and already this close to Clean-Architecture shape — an extra service layer would add indirection without adding testability or reuse value.
